draft_en.subject: Industrial switch from ISAF - PoE / non-PoE / managed, three prices
draft_en.body:
Hi Savaş,

We met at ISAF 2025 in Istanbul last October - this picks up what we discussed at the booth.

The industrial switch you asked for, DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, -40 to 75 C, in three versions: with PoE+ (unmanaged) model STI-288GP - $59.8 USD EXW; without PoE, model STI-280GE - $48.6; L2+ managed with PoE+, model STI-288DGGPM - $137.5 (all MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS).

One question: does your application need PoE and management, or plain switching?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
